description.zh:
待删除的标签列表。

TagKey：资源的标签键。取值范围：最大长度为64个字符，可包含英文大小写字母、中文、数字和特殊符号@_-=+;:,<.>/?

TagValue：资源的标签值。取值范围：最大长度为128个字符，可包含英文大小写字母、中文、数字和特殊符号@_-=+;:,<.>/?
description.en:
The list of tags to remove.

TagKey: The tag key. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: @ \_ - = + ; : , < . > / ?

TagValue: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: @ \_ - = + ; : , < . > / ?
